summary: Fintech products for venues and merchants, shipped to web, iOS and Android.
highlights: Led development of the Box Office web panel: ticket and product sales, wallet top-ups, customer management and reporting, used daily by venue staff; installable PWA with real-time updates over WebSockets (React, RTK Query, Zod).
Developed the JoyPort customer wallet app for iOS, Android and web: OTP sign-in, onboarding, QR payments and account management (Expo, Expo Router, NativeWind, Reanimated).
Core developer of the company's React component library, 50+ components documented in Storybook; contributed to its React Native counterpart (Radix UI, Tailwind).
Delivered the PAX POS device mode with NFC card payments in the merchant terminal app, a customer-facing ticket booking site, and wallet and payment features in the WaaS web app.
Contributed to the backend: Hono microservices on Bun (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Pusher) and the Laravel API (Octane, Filament); built the open-source hono-telescope to debug the services.
Merged 440+ merge requests across 20 repositories and reviewed 340+ from teammates (GitLab), in two-week Scrum sprints (Jira).
